title: Damped oscillator energy never increases
statement: Every global differentiable solution of q̇ = v and m v̇ = −kq − γv has antitone mechanical energy.
assumptions: The two HasDerivAt equations hold at every real time.
physical_scope: Unforced scalar viscously damped harmonic oscillator on all ℝ. The theorem is conditional on a global solution.
target_source:
import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

theorem classical_target (q v : ℝ → ℝ) (m k γ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hk : 0 < k) (hγ : 0 ≤ γ)
    (hq : ∀ t, HasDerivAt q (v t) t)
    (hv : ∀ t, HasDerivAt v ((-k * q t - γ * v t) / m) t) :
    Antitone (fun t => m / 2 * (v t)^2 + k / 2 * (q t)^2) := by
  sorry
